public_rationale: The technical accounts support a narrower reading: the reported behavior involved familiar defensive work that other models could perform. The claim therefore remains unresolved at the specificity supplied by the normalized proposition.
limitations: Reading the claim merely as saying that jailbreaks generally were old would produce a different assessment.

Known software flaws and known safeguard weaknesses are different facts.
